pose_convention: Roblox: position (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, y), so the front is -Z (LookVector). *_angles_roblox_deg
go to CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x), math.rad(y), math.rad(z)); body_cframe_roblox is the
same Body CFrame as CFrame.new(table.unpack(t)), relative to the prop pivot or HumanoidRootPart.
For a cat with `scale` s (Ragdoll, Maine Coon 1.2) multiply every pose position by s.

upright.note: Stands on the hind legs, the base of the bin traps. Working cats sit on body B instead (CatCafe_Cat_<Name>_Sit).

carried.note: Cradled across the chest, facing the character's left, so the camera behind the player sees the cat side on. Relative to the HumanoidRootPart centre (R15: 3 studs above the floor).

lick.note: Sitting, washing a paw: the left front paw up at the mouth, head tipped down to it (Derek 2026-10-27: the paw-up sit is licking a paw).

loaf.note: Lying down, belly on the floor, paws folded under.

sleep.note: The loaf with the head down and turned, tail curled round the side.

eat.note: Standing, head down to a bowl in front of the front paws.

CatCafe_VFX_ShinySparkle.use: ParticleEmitter.Texture for the ShinySparkle preset; tint with Color

suggested_emitter.parent: the cat's Body (emits from its box)
